title: Translation as institution
subtitle: From individual language ability to urban knowledge production
shortSummary: Translation is not only the exchange of words; it depends on sites, people, versions, review and relations of power.
curatorialDescription: The Xuanzang and Yijing records show how pilgrimage and translation entered the monasteries, court and knowledge institutions of Chang'an.
This is a curatorial analytic tool, not a claim that every translation practice followed one institutional model.
researchNote: Translation bureaux, participants, base texts, catalogues and passages still need item-level links to verifiable sources.
